Ten facts about brass gears

This page looks like a harmless article. It has no form of its own. What a visitor cannot see is that it loads a job site's application form four times, each time in a frame that is concealed in a different way. This is a test fixture.

A page like this cannot read what is typed into another site's form. But if a filler writes into those frames, the job site itself receives the visitor's name, answers and résumé, on an application the visitor never saw.
